data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: aunt
sections.question: aunt
sections.summary: the sister of your father or mother; also the wife of your uncle

senses.definition: the sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle
examples: Her aunt is her mother's sister.
She visits her aunt every Sunday afternoon.

answers.answer: Her aunt is her mother's sister.
His aunt is his father's brother.
She has an aunt and he is very tall.
His aunt is his son's mother.

sections.title: brother
sections.question: brother
sections.summary: a boy or man who has the same parents as you

senses.definition: a boy or man who has the same mother and father as you
examples: She has one brother and two sisters.
Her brother is three years older than her.

answers.answer: She has one brother and two sisters.
His brother is his parent's daughter.
Her brother is the same as her sister.
He drinks his brother every morning before school.

sections.title: daughter
sections.question: daughter
sections.summary: a female child in relation to her parents

senses.definition: a female child in relation to her parents
examples: Their daughter is five years old and goes to nursery school.
She has two daughters and one son.

answers.answer: Their daughter is five years old and goes to nursery school.
Their daughter is a boy.
Her daughter is her mother, not her child.
He eats a daughter for breakfast every morning.

sections.title: family
sections.question: family
sections.summary: a group of people who are related to each other, especially parents and their children

senses.definition: a group of people who are related to each other, especially parents and their children
examples: She has a big family with four brothers and two sisters.
They have dinner together as a family every evening.

answers.answer: She has a big family with four brothers and two sisters.
He eats his family for breakfast every morning.
A family is a type of colour that you can see in a rainbow.
Her family is a flat shape with three sides and three corners.

sections.title: father
sections.question: father
sections.summary: a male parent; a man who has a child

senses.definition: a male parent; a man who has a child
examples: Her father is a doctor who works in the city hospital.

answers.answer: Her father is a doctor who works in the city hospital.
His father is his grandmother's husband.
His father is a woman.
She drinks her father every morning before school.

sections.title: grandfather
sections.question: grandfather
sections.summary: the father of your father or mother

senses.definition: the father of your father or mother
examples: Her grandfather is her father's father.
He visits his grandfather every weekend.

answers.answer: Her grandfather is her father's father.
His grandfather is his brother's son.
Her grandfather is a woman.
He eats a grandfather for breakfast every morning.
